India Pursues Trade and Investment Ties with Multiple Nations

India has engaged in separate discussions to strengthen trade and investment relationships with Afghanistan, Finland, Estonia, and Thailand. These diplomatic efforts involve high-level delegations and ministerial meetings aimed at fostering economic cooperation, including potential free trade agreements and easier business access. The engagements highlight India's focus on expanding its global economic partnerships.
